hero.title: File:SiegeOfQuebec1759ByDesBarres.jpg
hero.credit:
Boston Public Library Digital Maps Collection

Call Number: G1106.P5 1777 .D4
hero.description: This is a map depicting the troop arrangements at the 1759 Siege of Quebec.  The caption reads: A Plan of Quebec and Environs, with its Defenses and the occasional entrenched Camps of the French commanded by Marquis de Montcalme; shewing likewise the principal Works and Operations of the British Forces, under the command of Major General Wolfe, during the Siege of that Place in 1759.
categories: Maps of the Battle of the Plains of Abraham
